subject: Final execution plan, signing rhythm, and start-date alignment
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@auroraretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@auroraretail.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + evaluation timeline (MAP attached)

Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Aurora is excited about the latency/cost profile you walked us through. As discussed, attached is our working MAP (Aurora_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a proposed evaluation plan so we can get to a decision. High-level asks from our side: 

- Confirmation of the final approver(s) on Redwood's side.
- A committed signature window so procurement can line up a PO and DocuSign slot.
- A target start date for onboarding and data transfer.

Key milestones (from Aurora MAP):
- Eval testbed delivery: Sep 13
- 2-week load/latency eval: Sep 14–Sep 27
- Legal/Proc review: Sep 14–Sep 21
- Target signing window: Sep 20–24 (we can be flexible by a couple days)
- Requested operational start: Oct 5 (Aurora prefers first week of Oct)

Please review the MAP and confirm who will sign on Redwood's side and the earliest DocuSign availability. Procurement is on the thread (procurement@auroraretail.com) to coordinate the PO.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Partnerships | Aurora Retail
olivia@auroraretail.com

Attachment: Aurora_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@auroraretail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation timeline (MAP attached)

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick read and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Internal approvers: Marissa (VP Sales) will sign commercial acceptance; final finance approval is Marcus Lin (CFO).
2) Legal will run a concise redline pass; Ben (cc'd) will send a one-page summary and a redline PDF.
3) Proposed signing window: Sep 22–24 (we can aim for a 30–60 minute DocuSign slot).
4) Tentative start date: to be conservative, propose Oct 7 as the operational kickoff (slight buffer for procurement + onboarding).

Ben — can you prioritize a redline by EOD Monday (Sep 13)? Olivia / Procurement — if you can tentatively hold one hour on Sep 23 between 09:00–12:00 PT for signing, that will give us flexibility to close.

I attached our baseline terms for reference (Redwood-Terms-Initial.pdf) — will follow up once Ben posts the redline.

– Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: Redwood-Terms-Initial.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@auroraretail.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation timeline (redline summary)

Karthik / Marissa — quick summary after a focused review of Aurora_MAP_v3 and Redwood-Terms-Initial: 

Top items (expect minimal negotiation):
- Data retention & deletion: propose a 90-day KV cache retention default with an option for custom retention in the Private deployment clause.
- SLA clarifications: quantify p95 latency targets for eval traffic and a 30-day remediation window for systemic degradations.
- Indemnity & IP: standard mutual indemnities; Aurora requested some narrow language on model misuse — we can add clarifying language rather than broadening liability.
- Export control & compliance: Aurora asked for SOC2 evidence; we have a SOC2 summary and can provide the SOC2 report under NDA.

I attached a redline PDF with edits and a one-page change log (Redwood-Terms-Redline_20260912.pdf). My recommendation: 
- Minor commercial concessions only if Aurora confirms a 12-month commit.
- Lock signing window Sep 23 10:00–11:00 PT for DocuSign and route to Marcus (CFO) for final sign.

If everyone is aligned, we should schedule a 20–30 minute call early next week to run through the handful of open items so procurement can prep the PO.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-Terms-Redline_20260912.pdf (pdf)

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 11:02 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks Olivia — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick read and next steps from Redwood: ...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@auroraretail.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation timeline (approval and signature cadence)

All — quick alignment from an approvals perspective. I reviewed Ben's redline and agree with his recommendations. Summary and plan: 

- Approvers: Marissa Cole (VP Sales) + Marcus Lin (CFO) will be the Redwood signers. Marcus is cc'd to confirm availability.
- Signing slot: Lock Sep 23, 2026 at 10:00–11:00 PT for DocuSign. That gives both sides time to incorporate Ben's edits into the final DocuSign packet.
- Start date: Approve Oct 12 as the operational kickoff. Rationale: Aurora's requested early Oct start is reasonable but we need two full weeks post-signature to complete onboarding tasks (data handoff window, SSO/KMS setup, and initial runbook sync).
- Onboarding items to confirm before signing: SSO domain allowlist, KMS key policy (if using customer-managed keys), and SOC2 report NDA.

Please confirm: 1) that Aurora can commit to signing on Sep 23 at 10:00 PT, and 2) whether Oct 12 as the start date works for your internal calendar. Once we have confirmation I will instruct Legal to finalize the DocuSign packet and instruct Finance to expect a PO.

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: MAP_Signature_Schedule.csv (csv stub)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@auroraretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@auroraretail.com, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + evaluation timeline — confirm Sep 23 signing and Oct 12 start

Marissa / Karthik — confirmed. Procurement has held Sep 23 10:00–11:00 PT for the DocuSign slot and will issue the PO the same day following signature. Marcus — thanks for being on the thread; our legal team has accepted the redline edits and we are ready to proceed.

DocuSign envelope: https://na1.docusign.net/Envelopes/1234
PO contact: procurement@auroraretail.com (cc'd)

We accept Oct 12 as the operational kickoff. For the onboarding checklist: Aurora will provide the SFTP endpoint and the KMS contact by Sep 20 so your infra team can start the allowlist and key exchange.

Looking forward to getting this across the line — see you on Sep 23 for the e-sign.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Partnerships | Aurora Retail
olivia@auroraretail.com

Attachment stub: PO_pending_Aurora_20260923.pdf (pdf reference)
